json_schema.title: parted_partition.get_id
json_schema.description: Returns the system ID of a specific partition, such as Linux, NTFS, LVM, etc. (NOTE: feature may not be available depending on your versions of parted on minions)

device.ui:title: Device
device.ui:description: The full path to the block device (e.g., /dev/sda)

minor.ui:title: Minor
minor.ui:description: The partition number (minor number), such as 1 for /dev/sda1
